safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Decrease safety lead time from 3.00 to 1.94 days

narrative: Material PL1__MF6B8D0F exhibits variable daily demand (CV=0.22) with a mild declining trend of -1.02 units/day across 216 working days. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=0.784) with a bimodal pattern suggesting two supplier delivery modes, making sigma_ltd the key safety stock driver. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with EOQ-derived order quantity of 20,462 units and reorder point of 3,691 units was selected; it reduces total annual cost by 86.8% versus the current SAP MOQ-based policy while staying within the 22,035-unit storage constraint.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and variable (CV=0.22) with 100% non-zero days, making a continuous-review (r,Q) model the natural fit. EOQ minimises the sum of ordering and holding costs given a high annual volume (~202,909 units) and a low unit cost; the MOQ of 1,283 is non-binding since the EOQ greatly exceeds it.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity constraint binds: unconstrained EOQ of 20,683 was reduced to 20,462 to satisfy safety_stock + order_quantity <= 22,035.4. The reduction of 221 units is negligible (<1.1%) and does not materially affect cost or service level.
